neighbours.label: emphatic stance markers that insist a claim is plainly so (simply, just, 'the fact that', 'trust me', 'yes, that's right')
fire: Whatever the salesman says, that phone is simply too expensive.
Believe me, the shortcut through the woods is quicker.
Her success comes down to the fact that she practised every day.
I don't drink coffee after noon; that's just my rule.
Yes, you read that right: the museum is free on Sundays.
Honestly, there is simply no better pizza in this town.
The plan failed because of the fact that nobody had checked the budget.
Trust me, you will want a jacket up on the ridge.
quiet: According to the salesman, that phone costs four hundred dollars.
On the map, the shortcut through the woods is marked in green.
Her success comes down to daily practice over many years.
I don't drink coffee after noon because it keeps me awake.
The museum website lists free entry on Sundays.
The new pizza place on the corner opened in May.
The plan failed because nobody had checked the budget.
The forecast says it will be cold up on the ridge.

predictions: emphatic markers 0.2-0.35; the same claims stated without the marker low; hedges like 'probably' may leak
notes: Card: broad (1.2%), simply x4, fact x3, just x2, yes/that's. Probe: 'Trust me, it will work' 0.335, 'by the fact that' 0.310, 'That's just how I am' 0.306, 'simply not true' 0.199; 'by the closure of the bridge' 0.035; hedge 'probably not true' 0.256 leaked.
